findings.highlight: I charge at her to push her away
findings.evidenceJa: 肩から体当たりして、遠坂を弾き飛ばす
findings.governingReading: He body-checks Tohsaka shoulder-first and knocks her flying aside.
findings.explanation: The English weakens the desperate shoulder impact and its forceful result.
The English invents a piercing quality that anticipates a puncture rather than reporting the heard impact.

findings.evidenceJa: 視界がぐにゃぐにゃに曲がっていく
findings.governingReading: His field of vision bends and warps as though under a severe fever.
findings.explanation: Active visual distortion becomes generic haziness.

findings.governingReading: Sakura stares blankly at Shirou while still clawing at her chest.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s continuing violent bodily distress disappears.

findings.highlight: The cut from grabbing the knife
findings.governingReading: the left hand that gripped the knife
findings.explanation: The English invents a cut; the source identifies the painful hand by what it gripped, without diagnosing a cutting wound.

findings.highlight: It stabbed and entangled around my arm
findings.evidenceJa: 俺に伸びたソレは、遠坂の代わりに俺の左腕に巻きつき
findings.governingReading: The thing extended toward Shirou and coiled around his left arm in Rin’s place.
findings.explanation: The English invents a stabbing impact and omits the specifically left arm.

findings.highlight: Sakura fainted when she saw me fall
findings.evidenceJa: 桜は俺が倒れたのと同時に気を失った
findings.governingReading: Sakura lost consciousness at the same time Shirou collapsed.
findings.explanation: The English changes simultaneity into Sakura fainting in reaction to seeing Shirou fall.
